t: Zonko's Joke Shop | Harry Potter Wiki | Fandom
s: January 9, 2026 - Zonko's Joke Shop was a wizarding joke shop located in the wizarding village of Hogsmeade, Scotland.[2] By at least 1890, it was a favourite place for Hogwarts students to shop on Hogsmeade trips.[3] In the 1980s, it was owned by Bilton Bilmes.[4] In the late 19th century, the shop was run by an unidentified shopkeeper.
